adapted_from.source_text:
Style: naive folk art like Henri Rousseau: flat perspective, meticulous leaves and plants, childlike sincerity, lush greens.

Subject: a seven-year-old child sitting on a cushioned window seat, reading an open picture book, a small cat curled up asleep beside the child, a potted plant on the windowsill, soft afternoon light coming through the window.

Render the whole image faithfully in this one style, so the style is instantly recognizable. Vertical 3:4 composition. No subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no signature, no logo.
